title: agoseris greenei
intro: Agoseris greenei, commonly known as Greenes daisy or mountain daisy, is a perennial plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in Agoseris greenei include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Agoseris greenei make it a potential natural remedy for various conditions, including skin infections, wounds, and inflammatory diseases.
